description:
Phase 5. LANDED (PRs #193 + #194): olivine idle spin-down (opt-in idle_timeout worker param, client-reads-only activity, compaction-format snapshot upload gating the exit, {:shutdown, :idle}, deferred foreman self-removal after own exit) and the distributor's idle branch ({:shutdown, :idle} -> park without recruit; degraded park falls back to heal; idle check defers while :locked or compacting; unlock resets the idle clock).

RE-ADOPTION RESIDUE (PR pending on feature/q67.21.5b-adoption): the FDB sanity check killed the planned services-snapshot identification sweep — recovery's locking phase already locks every advertised materializer and bootstrap adopts every locked survivor, so a side-channel sweep would rediscover only what bootstrap found, and it violates keyspace-is-the-channel. The true residue is a family-named worker the epoch never embraced (node missed roll call, rejoined later) — which is exactly bedrock-q67.21.7. Collapsed into ONE mechanism: sweep-time assignment verification (probe each named assignment's :epoch; current -> silent; stale -> adopt = lock at epoch + unlock at own durable version + fenced re-assert; unadoptable -> heal, never remove — displacement retires the stray in-band). Unnamed strays need nothing: rejoin_verdict :displaced already self-retires them.

REMAINING:
1. Production wiring for "idle_timeout" (deliberately deferred from PR #194 / audit F4): nothing sets the param yet. Decide the config source (cluster config knob through the director's recruitment_ctx) and a default policy; opt-in shape keeps the system shard exempt by construction.

RESIDUALS inherited from bedrock-q67.21.4 (audits of PRs #190/#191):
- N2: covered-before-caught-up telemetry breadcrumb.
- Placeholder fit: repo traffic parks ~50ms per attempt; consider a hold-aware fetch timeout for known-placeholder routes; decide with measurements.
title: Idle spin-down + re-adoption residue
